semiconductor_relevance: High — Pace-Tec GmbH specializes in customized wet treatment solutions for semiconductor processing, making it a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: Pace-Tec GmbH is a medium-sized company that designs and manufactures customized wet benches for various wet chemical processes in semiconductor manufacturing. Their systems support applications such as cleaning, etching, developing, and drying of wafers, offering both manual and fully automated solutions tailored to customer specifications.
capabilities: Custom wet benches for wafer surface treatment
Manual and automated wet chemical processing systems
SC1/SC2 cleaning and RCA cleaning solutions
